text:
maya: Heads-up — saw several customer reports where token billing doesn't match console counters for streaming responses + retries. Repro steps incoming.
maya: Minimal repro: client streams, network blips, client reconnects with same request id, server replays remaining tokens. Console shows full response tokens but billing shows partial/unexpected deltas.
devin: Oof. Do we have idempotency keys today? I thought streaming didn't support them well.
maya: We set X-Request-Id for top-level requests but streaming PDUs are separate. Logs show events: `stream_start`, `delta_token_count`, `stream_end`. Retry creates another `stream_start` for same X-Request-Id and we end up double-counting deltas.
harper: Can you paste the event snippet?
maya: Sure:
```
{"req_id":"r-123","event":"delta_token","tokens":42}
{"req_id":"r-123","event":"delta_token","tokens":18}
{"req_id":"r-123","event":"stream_end","total":60}
# retry
{"req_id":"r-123","event":"delta_token","tokens":20}
{"req_id":"r-123","event":"stream_end","total":80}
```
maya: Console shows total 80, billing pipeline counted 100 because reconstruction + finalization pipeline summed both streams incorrectly.
sarah: Tool calls make this worse. When a model returns a tool call we add tool response tokens when we feed the tool output back into the model. Are we attributing those tokens to the original request or to the tool invocation?
devin: Current pipeline only tags tokens as `response` or `prompt`. Tools get merged into `prompt` after execution, so attribution flips mid-request.
harper: Proposal: canonicalize a request-level UUID (idempotency) that all streaming PDUs and tool callbacks must reference. At billing ingestion we dedupe by (req_uuid, sequence_number) and use `finalized=true` markers to prevent premature charge.
maya: Also need to decide when quotas are checked/enforced. Do we decrement quota on token reservation (start) or on finalize? Customers expect quotas to protect them from runaway costs.
sarah: For retries, I vote reservations at start + release on finalize/failure. But streaming chunk reservations complicate this with partial failures.
ops-bot: incident created: #INC-2024-79 token-accounting-streaming (assigned: devin)
devin: For immediate mitigation I can add a short-term server-side dedupe: keep a 5-minute sliding window of seen (req_uuid, pdu_hash) and ignore duplicates before billing. Not perfect but buys time.
harper: Long-term: change schema to emit these fields per token event: `req_uuid`, `pdu_seq`, `pdu_done`, `origin` (model/tool), and `finalized_checksum`. Billing will compute delta only when `pdu_done==true` OR when we've seen a finalized checksum.
maya: UX ask: in Console we should show a per-request token waterfall: prompt/system/model/tool/stream-retries. Right now it's opaque and drives support tickets.
sarah: Also add a telemetry counter for "tokens attributed to tool" vs "tokens from tool" so we can spot feedback loops.
devin: Implementing: 1) X-Request-Id enforcement across websocket/framer 2) add pdu_seq monotonic counter 3) server dedupe middleware 4) update billing ingestion to prefer finalized_checksum if present.
maya: I'll draft an RFC with examples and edge-cases (truncation, partial tool outputs, stream truncation due to max_tokens). Who wants to review?
harper: I will. Also we should add unit tests simulating flaky networks + reconnects.
sarah: I'll add console mockups for the waterfall.
maya: Great. Action items: RFC (#rfc-token-accounting) by EOD Tuesday, devin to deploy dedupe middleware as hotfix, harper to add tests, sarah to prototype UX.
devin: On it. :+1:
maya: Thanks team. :)
